scope: Cognigrex internal operational canon through external-party/public/legal/financial/irreversible gates

decisions.title: CGX operational-canon authority transition
decisions.rule: Cognigrex/.cgx is the target live operational canon and distributed runtime. During bootstrap, Google Drive may anchor exact recovery carriers and durable recovery evidence. GitHub remains source-code/schema/test/provenance/receipt infrastructure. Drive remains archive/evidence/recovery/export/interchange infrastructure. Neither GitHub nor Drive is a required runtime dependency of the final Cognigrex operational canon.
decisions.bootstrap_authority: Google Drive exact recovery carrier/readback anchor while distributed CGX persistence and governance promotion remain unproven
decisions.target_operational_authority: Cognigrex distributed .cgx environment across promoted nodes

support_surfaces.github: source code, schemas, tests, version history, engineering provenance and auditable receipts
support_surfaces.google_drive: bootstrap recovery anchor, human-accessible evidence/archive, export/interchange and disaster-recovery copy

decisions.independence_invariant: Promoted Cognigrex distributed operation must continue within its authorised envelope when GitHub and Google Drive are unavailable.
decisions.transition_gate: CGX-LAUNCH-009 after CGX-LAUNCH-005, CGX-LAUNCH-007 and CGX-LAUNCH-008 are empirically closed; no authority transition is inferred before the exact governance/carrier state is promoted.

decisions.title: Standing internal execution authority
decisions.rule: Internal + reversible + evidence-bound + within an ACTIVE execution lease may execute without per-action founder reapproval. External, irreversible, governance-changing, public, legal, financial, IP-ownership-changing or physical-actuation actions remain explicitly gated.
standing_scope: corpus reconciliation and canonical data assembly
schema migration within approved compatibility and rollback bounds
reversible internal digital writes with readback and rollback/recovery references
object population where unknowns remain explicit and no unsupported claim is promoted
explicit_owner_gate_remains_for: promotion of a new distributed governance authority state
permanent deletion of irreplaceable evidence or recovery lineage
contracts, legal commitments, financial commitments or material IP-ownership changes
irreversible physical actuation or physical safety-boundary changes
any requested authority expansion beyond the currently promoted envelope
decisions.audit_separation: Achilles remains an independent audit/stop/quarantine/re-proof authority and does not become a competing operational executor.
decisions.prelaunch_binding: This receipt is the standing RootAuthority authorization that may be referenced by otherwise-valid PRE_LAUNCH internal execution leases. It does not satisfy public-release, external-action, physical-safety or empirical-evidence gates.

non_effects: Does not synthetically close CGX-LAUNCH-005 durable child persistence.
Does not close CGX-LAUNCH-007 physical multi-device/non-loopback proof.
Does not close CGX-LAUNCH-008 platform keystore/recovery proof.
Does not promote CGX-LAUNCH-009 distributed governance.
Does not authorize public release, external-party contact, contracts, financial/legal commitments or irreversible physical actuation.
